summary: aTyr Pharma filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting preliminary Q1 cash of $68.3M and a clinical update for efzofitimod after an FDA Type C meeting. The FDA recommended a new Phase 3 study in pulmonary sarcoidosis with updated endpoints (FVC primary, KSQ-Lung secondary) and population (restrictive lung disease). No special situation—no M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic review. Routine operational update.
